versions.subject: fix: FPs from fresh Windows 2022 install
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features\TamperProtection'
    Details: DWORD (0x00000000)
filter_msmpeng: # only disabled temporarily during updates
    Image|startswith: 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
    Image|endswith: '\MsMpEng.exe'
condition: selection and not filter_msmpeng
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="*\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Features\\TamperProtection*" Details="DWORD (0x00000000)" NOT (Image="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*" Image="*\\MsMpEng.exe")

versions.subject: fix: FPs found in win2022 domain controller baseline
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features\TamperProtection'
    Details: DWORD (0x00000000)
filter_msmpeng_client: # only disabled temporarily during updates
    Image|startswith: 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
    Image|endswith: '\MsMpEng.exe'
filter_msmpeng_domain_controller: # only disabled temporarily during updates
    Image: 'C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MsMpEng.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="*\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Features\\TamperProtection*" Details="DWORD (0x00000000)" NOT ((Image="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*" Image="*\\MsMpEng.exe") OR Image="C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\MsMpEng.exe")
